healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Managed outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and multi-specialty practices (via HMCA), plus MRI scanner manufacturing

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Diagnostic imaging (MRI), including upright multi-position spine imaging; multi-specialty practices

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Management fees from managed practices plus fee-for-service scan billing, with equipment sales and service

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Manages a network of diagnostic imaging centers and multi-specialty practices, mainly in New York and Florida

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix

notes: FONAR both manufactures MRI scanners and manages imaging centers via HMCA; evidence gives no payer, volume or quality data.
